ammonia.reason: No surface flora and 18-20% brine anaerobic ripening limits deamination and urea catabolism to NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and no p-cresol/indole reported; clean lactic flora without Brevibacterium.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis accentuated by 3.57% NaCl and pH 5.46 to 4.4.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; low methyl ketones 2-heptanone 3.76 mg/kg and 2-nonanone 1.6 mg/kg only.

browning.reason: High moisture 61.8% and high salt plus low residual lactose inhibit Maillard and caramelization.

buttery.reason: Citrate to diacetyl/acetoin by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis, curtailed by salt-in-moisture and short brine age.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipolysis FFAs butanoic 337 mg/kg, hexanoic 707 mg/kg, octanoic 1014 mg/kg from milk lipase and starter esterases.

creaminess.reason: High moisture 61.8% with 15.45% fat gives moist mouthfeel but brine Ca-bridging limits cream flow.

crumbliness.reason: pH fall 5.46 to ~4.5 toward casein isoelectric point plus Na-Ca exchange in brine demineralizes paracasein.

firmness.reason: Pressed rennet gel firmed by 20% brine NaCl despite 61.8% moisture; sliceable soft-brined body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine Ehrlich to 2-phenylethanol 2.48 mg/kg and delta-decalactone 2.02 mg/kg lactonization, low level.

fruity.reason: Esterase esterification to ethyl hexanoate 3.99 mg/kg; ethanol limiting in anaerobic brine.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic goaty acids; only straight-chain C6-C8 gives slight caprylic note.

malty_nutty.reason: Little Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and propanal; short age limits leucine/isoleucine catabolism and pyrazines.

melt.reason: 3.57% salt and pH ~4.5-5.46 crosslink Ca-paracasein; acid-brined curd softens but does not flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Linoleic lipoxygenase to 1-octen-3-ol only 0.89 mg/kg; no Geotrichum/white mold.

oil_off.reason: Low fat 15.45% trapped in high-salt protein matrix; no cooking or pasta-filata fat release.

smoky.reason: Not smoked and no guaiacol/phenols reported; pasteurized 68C for 20 min adds no pyrolysis.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactose to L-lactic plus acetic 654 mg/kg and propanoic 12 mg/kg by mesophilic starters in brine.

stretch.reason: No hot-water kneading or aligned paracasein; rennet-brined curd fractures rather than strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/DMS not detected; low-heat pasteurization limits whey beta-lactoglobulin H2S release.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose depleted by fermentation and salt suppresses sweet; slight lactone sweetness only.

umami.reason: Short 28-day brine proteolysis yields low free glutamate; salt enhances but no long glutamate accumulation.
